To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of ripe Cavendishes banana flour in wheat flour can reduce the amount of starch gelatinisation and retrogradation.
the addition of banana flour in the wheat flour could reduce cooking time of wheat flour, which is a great advantage in food processing.
the presence of soluble carbohydrate in RBF would delay granular swelling and starch gelatinisation of WF-RBF, and this would reduce the pasting and gelatinisation properties of WF-RBF.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the physicochemical, pasted and gel textural changes of WF-RBF and the potential of WF-RBF as a functional ingredient for use in food applications.
the physicochemical and pasting properties of wheat- ripe banana composite flours prepared by partial substitution with ripe Cavendish bananas flour.
the preparation and physicochemical, pasted and gel textural characterisation of WF-RBFs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of soluble sugars in WF-RBF could reduce the gelatinisation temperature of WF-RBF, and increase solubility index and firmness of the gel.
the physicochemical, pastel and gel textural changes of the WF-RBF are mainly attributed to the presence of soluble sugars and minerals in RBF.
the addition of RBF to WF could be used to produce WF-RBF with improved physicochemical, pasted and gel textural characteristics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WF-RBF gelling behaviour could be controlled by varying RBF content.

the use of ripe banana flour in the preparation of composite flour for the production of noodles would be a promising strategy to improve the nutritional and textural qualities of wheat noodles, and to increase its shelf life.
WF-RBF could be used to replace WF to produce healthier and more nutritious products.
The main takeaway from our work is that
WF-RBF could be a suitable ingredient for the production of gluten-free food products.
WF-RBF gelled more readily and could be used in the preparation of food products such as noodles and dumplings.
the physicochemical and gel textural characteristics of WF-RBF could be tailored by varying the proportion of WF and RBF.
